result.brief: 面向去中心化多智能体强化学习，提出反事实语义-社会世界模型为独立PPO策略提供上下文引导，属于机器人/控制类应用，与视频或多模态基础世界模型及视觉表征学习无直接关联。
result.reason: Main contribution is a decentralized MARL policy framework with counterfactual social world models for agent control; no video/multimodal foundation world model or visual representation contribution.
